parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json);const invalid=[];let total=0;const byCategory={};for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){const r=rows[i];const amount=Number(r.amount);if(!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<0){invalid.push({index:i,reason:"amount must be a non-negative number"});continue;}total+=amount;const c=String(r.category||"Uncategorized");byCategory[c]=(byCategory[c]||0)+amount;}return [{json:{recordCount:rows.length,validExpenseCount:rows.length-invalid.length,invalidRecords:invalid,total,byCategory,currency:"Set your currency before reporting",generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];
